headings: Enedis module,Testing against the Enedis sandbox
content: According to Enedis, the metering (mesure_synchrone_auto) APIs cannot be tested in the Enedis sandbox, as it returns placeholder dates such as 20XX-XX-XX instead of real measurements. To verify metering requests you need to use the production Enedis API with a PRM for which the user has given their consent to your application.
